facts.fact: 梦的开幕改为「愿望清单巡礼」：收藏在 app 里没去过的地（前晚苏格兰高地、泰国海滩）。
facts.anchor: This is how my dreams always start now.

facts.fact: 梦里唯一不变的是那条粉色长裙——不是她自选的，却让她觉得几乎漂亮。
facts.anchor: I shift to stroll across an empty piazza before noticing the dress draped over my body.

facts.fact: 核心顿悟：梦=「从另一个人的眼里看到的她」；造梦者认为她值得。
facts.anchor: This is the moment when it always shifts; the moment I realize these dreams aren’t truly me, but the me as seen from another’s eyes.

facts.fact: 27 年的空痛在梦里变淡——像带她来的男人想替她挡掉最糟的部分。
facts.anchor: It’s a familiar feeling, this hollow, yet dense, ache—the same one I’ve carried for the last twenty-seven years of my life.

facts.fact: 他的身形逐梦清晰（高一头/黑大衣/非人静止）但脸被白布罩住——像倒戴的葬礼面纱。
facts.anchor: But his face…I still cannot see his face.

facts.fact: 今夜她第一次开口（你是谁/花是你留的吗/你想要什么/你是真的吗）——他只给微反应从不答话。
facts.anchor: “Are you the one leaving the flowers?” I snatch my bottom lip between aching teeth

facts.fact: 最后一步她没迈——直觉警告跨界会改变一切。
facts.anchor: Something warns me that crossing that final boundary would change things in ways I’m not prepared for.

facts.fact: 醒来夜柜有红玫瑰：盛放瞬间压制、无茎、深红吸光——「It's not real」被实物反杀。
facts.anchor: There, resting against the base of my lamp, is today’s offering.
